taste:
This basket combines a pronounced breadcrumb crunch with tender, juicy chicken breast and a gently spiced, savoury flavour. The coating brings herbs and spices into each bite, but the heat is described as subtle rather than strong. If you want seasoned chicken without an overly hot finish, that balance is the main reason to choose it.

Five strips sit alongside a generous portion of golden chips, with a cooling dipping sauce of your choice. The basket presentation keeps the meal informal, while the dip provides a contrast to the warm seasoning. It is straightforward comfort food for a relaxed lunch or casual dinner, with texture as much of a draw as spice.
